36531f6ae562a7faf5511257079be711fc439381.en:
Project Background and Positioning

There are obvious shortcomings in the ability of a single large model: some are good at code and mathematical reasoning, but writing Chinese copywriting is rigid; some Chinese writing is fluent, but they are prone to errors in logic and calculations.In daily use, users often have to judge for themselves which model to ask this question, switch back and forth between different platforms, and cannot directly compare or synthesize the answers of multiple models.This is what this project is trying to solve: do a "multi-model collaboration" routing and orchestration prototype, use one portal to use the advantages of multiple models at the same time -
36531f6ae562a7faf5511257079be711fc439381.zh-TW:
專案背景與定位

單一大模型有明顯的能力短板：有的擅長程式碼和數學推理，但寫中文文案偏生硬；有的中文寫作流暢，卻容易在邏輯、計算上出錯。在日常使用中，使用者往往要自己判斷「這個問題該問哪個模型」，在不同平台之間來回切換，還無法直接對比或綜合多個模型的回答。這個專案想解決的就是這件事：做一個「多模型協作」的路由與編排原型，用一個入口同時用到多個模型的長處——

6ffe7a015380269d32374793c3e729462a5ae6a9.en:
A skill that helps students transform overly simplistic courseware into a knowledge manual that can be systematically and comprehensively learned. At the same time, in order to restore the classroom content as much as possible, this skill does not reconstruct the knowledge structure but retains the original courseware context, only adding intelligent explanations. To adapt to different disciplines, there are four modes available here, corresponding respectively to courses of computational proof type, example problem-oriented type, application type and theoretical reasoning type.

For cases where the uploaded materials contain pure images, this skill has added an OCR installation prompt. If recognition is not required, it will be automatically skipped.

At present, the various courses of CityUHK Computing Academy have been tested and adapted well.
6ffe7a015380269d32374793c3e729462a5ae6a9.zh-TW:
一個幫助同學將教授【過於簡略的課件】轉換為【可系統地、全方位地學習的知識手冊】的skill，同時為了盡最大可能還原課堂內容，此skill並不會重構知識結構，而會保留原有的課件脈絡，只增添智能講解。為了適應不同的學科，這裡有四個模式可使用，分別對應計算證明類/例題導向類/應用類/理論推理類的課程。對於上傳資料中含有純圖片的情況，本skill加了OCR安裝提示，若不需要辨識則會自動跳過。

目前對於CityUHK計算學院的各個課程已測試適配良好。

A nanny-level guide for professional review of the China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center Certification. The author graduated from the Master of Science (E-commerce) program at City University of Hong Kong. After obtaining the initial certification result from the Ministry of Education's China Academic Degrees and Graduate Education Development Center, he applied for a professional field review and changed the certified major from "E-commerce" to "Computer Science and Technology (E-commerce)". The warehouse has sorted out the complete process of this review, the full set of application material templates and the preparation ideas.

In many domestic positions, especially in the recruitment of civil servants and public institutions, majors are determined by the discipline directory. If the names of overseas majors are classified too finely or do not match the descriptions in the domestic directory, they are likely to be rejected in the initial screening. This guide is mainly written for the younger students of City University's MScEC program. Students from other overseas institutions who want to add a first-level discipline to their accreditation results can also refer to it.
ca5e7a8b0eb15bdb90f6a504799a2a4fdbca7403.zh-TW: 留服認證專業複審的保母級攻略。作者畢業於香港城市大學理學碩士（電子商貿）項目，拿到教育部留學服務中心的初次認證結果後申請專業領域複核，把認證專業從「電子商貿」改成了「電腦科學與技術（電子商貿）」。倉庫整理了這次覆核的完整流程、全套申請資料範本和準備想法。國內很多職位，尤其是公務員和事業單位招聘，會依學科目錄卡專業。境外專業名稱分得太細，或和國內目錄說法對不上，就容易在初篩被刷掉。這份攻略主要寫給城大MScEC 的學弟妹，其他境外院校想在認證結果裡補上一級學科的同學也可以參考。

f9a7319ce711fbf2aa6a1b560443c87478c8711a.en:
How to use it

Access to three models (DeepSeek is responsible for code and mathematical reasoning, Qwen is responsible for Chinese writing, and Kimi is responsible for general dialogue and long-text understanding), all of which are OpenAI compatible interfaces.Provide a double portal between the webpage window and the CLI, and fill in the API key in the upper right corner to use it.
f9a7319ce711fbf2aa6a1b560443c87478c8711a.zh-TW:
怎麼用

連結三個模型（DeepSeek 負責程式碼與數學推理、Qwen 負責中文寫作、Kimi 負責通用對話與長文理解），皆為OpenAI 相容介面。提供網頁視窗與CLI 雙入口，右上角填入API key 即用。

f9f88476949c165ac37d92f96c7b77385247227e.en: Fill in the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (local Ollama, or cloud services such as Bailian, DeepSeek, and Zhipu). If not filled in, it will return to RapidFuzz offline keyword matching
f9f88476949c165ac37d92f96c7b77385247227e.zh-TW: ：填入OpenAI 相容端點即可（本地Ollama，或百煉、DeepSeek、智譜這些雲端服務），不填就退回RapidFuzz 離線關鍵字匹配
